shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the lower marker at x = −1 in the left image with the marker at 2 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The increasing branch excludes (−1, 4) at its right boundary. Right image: The marked interval excludes its right endpoint 2.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image excludes the indicated boundary point. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
